patches.title: Central SSH execution
patches.neededFor: Hermes homes whose config runs tools on an SSH host without copying credentials, skills, or cache to it.

patches.title: Live subagent progress
patches.neededFor: Live progress for subagents Hermes delegates to. Without it, background subagents show as idle once dispatched.

patches.title: Subagents in the turn
patches.neededFor: Subagents that answer inside the turn and can launch their own, as Claude's do. Without it, Hermes runs every subagent in the background, so its answer arrives in a later turn, and a subagent cannot launch another.

patches.title: Background process reports
patches.neededFor: Monitoring status while Hermes's background processes run, and waking the agent when they finish. Without it, a background command reads as finished the moment it starts, and the agent never hears that it is done.

patches.title: Fast mode
patches.neededFor: Fast Mode on Hermes models. Applying it also turns fast mode on for CLIProxyAPI endpoints in your Hermes config. Without it, the Fast Mode toggle does not appear.

patches.title: Durable background results
patches.neededFor: Apply after Live subagent progress and Background process reports. Keeps a finished subagent's result until the agent has actually been woken with it, and redelivers results missed while T3 Code was disconnected or restarting.

patches.title: Reasoning shown once
patches.neededFor: Hermes models that return reasoning text, with display.show_reasoning on. Without it, an ACP reply repeats the streamed reasoning as a code block, followed by a second copy of the reply.

patches.title: Lost-turn refusals
patches.neededFor: Recovering a Hermes session after a gateway restart loses a turn. Without it, a prompt sent from T3 can be queued behind the lost turn while T3 shows it as failed, then run unseen once the lost turn is discarded.

patches.title: Full access on reopened sessions
patches.neededFor: Full access on a Hermes thread that was opened, or last ran, in another approval mode. Without it, switching an existing thread to Full access keeps asking for approval and its subagents keep denying dangerous commands, and switching away from Full access keeps approving everything.

patches.title: Clarifying questions
patches.neededFor: Hermes asking you a clarifying question with choices you can pick from. Without it, Hermes's T3 sessions have no clarify tool, so it asks in its reply and you answer with a new message.

patches.title: Live command output
patches.neededFor: Seeing a Hermes shell command's output while it runs. Without it, a command's card stays empty until the command finishes.

patches.title: Steering a running turn
patches.neededFor: A message you send while Hermes is working reaching the running turn, as it does for Claude and Codex. Without it, T3 stops the turn and starts it again with your message.
